examples.name: Valley
examples.description: A 2 km mountain valley to fly through, with a day and night cycle: landscape layers for ground, rock, snow, forest floor, roads and trails; meadow grass, spruce forest, oaks about the hamlet and bushes made with the Foliage Creator; a torch-lit hamlet with enterable houses, a windmill, a campfire, a pond with floating crates, mist and god rays, all lit by baked GI volumes and light probes. Play opens a menu: a cinematic tour of the valley (made with the sequencer) or a free camera to fly.

examples.name: Dungeon
examples.description: A souls-like in a three-level torch-lit dungeon: stamina combat, rolls, lock-on, a bonfire and Estus, Hollows, a sorcerer and an elite knight, breakable barrels, messages and pickups, and a boss behind a fog gate in its throne arena.

examples.name: Firing Line
examples.description: A first-person shooter: walk, sprint, crouch, aim down sights, hip and aimed fire, reloads and three weapons against bots that search, take cover, retreat when hurt and call for reinforcements. One scene, one Game Manager with a game-type list (one against all, team deathmatch, free for all): put the manager and some fighters in any scene and it plays.
